title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Chapter 2: A Week at the Mansion
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Second arc of the Re:ZERO manga. Subaru, a teen transported to a fantasy kingdom, can 'return by death', resetting time when he dies. After saving the half-elf Emilia, he wakes in the mansion of the magician Roswaal, who backs Emilia's bid for the throne, and takes a job under the twin maids Ram and Rem, where he uncovers a deadly plot he must survive by repeating the same week.
life_message: Persistence and loyalty to the people you care about are worth enduring repeated failure and pain.
